detail.title: Construction Project Manager
detail.jobDescription:
Founded in 2010, POP MART is a leading global pop culture and entertainment company. With IP at its core, POP MART works with artists and designers worldwide to develop and operate IPs, creating products, services and entertainment experiences for consumers. Its portfolio includes beloved IP characters such as THE MONSTERS , TWINKLE TWINKLE, CRYBABY, DIMOO, SKULLPANDA, Hirono and MOLLY. As of the first half of 2026, POP MART had more than 100 million registered members worldwide, operated 676 physical stores and over 2,800 ROBO SHOP vending machines, and reached nearly 100 countries and regions through cross-border e-commerce platforms,bringing joy to consumers around the world.





Construction Project Manager

Location: Culver City, CA
Department: Real Estate / Construction
Employment Type: Full-Time / Onsite 5x a Week
Travel: Approximately 35–40%
Salary: $120,000–$145,000


Opportunity Overview

POP MART is seeking an experienced Construction Project Manager to support the continued expansion of our retail footprint across the United States.

This role will manage multiple retail construction projects from pre-construction through store opening and handover, with responsibility for budgets, schedules, permitting, contractor management, construction execution, and project closeout. You will partner closely with internal Real Estate, Design, Store Operations, architects, general contractors, landlords, and vendors to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to POP MART's quality and brand standards.


The ideal candidate brings strong retail or commercial construction experience, can manage multiple projects simultaneously, and is comfortable operating in a fast-paced, rapidly growing environment.


We follow an office policy with an expectation of five days per week working onsite. Being together in person helps us collaborate, stay connected, and build a strong team culture.


What You Will Achieve


  • Manage multiple retail construction projects from pre-construction and bidding through construction, punch list, turnover, and store opening.
  • Develop, monitor, and manage project budgets, schedules, and key milestones while maintaining quality, safety, and brand standards.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, architects, engineers, landlords, general contractors, vendors, and other project partners throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Review General Contractor bids, support contractor selection, and manage contractor performance against approved scope, budget, and schedule.
  • Manage RFIs, submittals, change orders, proposal requests, supplemental instructions, and other construction documentation.
  • Partner with the Architect of Record (AOR) to ensure construction documents incorporate required design elements, internal and vendor markups, shop drawings, and technical requirements prior to bidding and construction.
  • Proactively identify project risks, schedule delays, cost impacts, and scope changes, developing mitigation and contingency plans as needed.
  • Lead recurring construction progress meetings and maintain clear documentation of project schedules, action items, change order logs, material approvals, and key decisions.
  • Conduct regular site visits to monitor construction progress, quality, safety, and adherence to approved plans and specifications.
  • Coordinate punch lists, inspections, project closeout, and handover to Store Operations to support successful and timely store openings.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Real Estate, Design, Store Operations, Procurement, Finance, and other stakeholders to support POP MART's U.S. retail expansion.
  • Identify opportunities to improve construction processes, project controls, vendor performance, and overall speed to market.

What You Will Need


  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 5–7 years of commercial construction project management experience, with retail construction strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple construction projects simultaneously from pre-construction through completion.
  • Strong knowledge of construction budgeting, scheduling, bidding, change orders, RFIs, submittals, permitting, and project closeout.
  • Experience working directly with architects, engineers, general contractors, landlords, vendors, and cross-functional business partners.
  • Strong financial and analytical skills with experience managing project budgets and identifying cost risks.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and aggressive project timelines.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and familiarity with construction/project management tools.
  • Ability to travel approximately 35–40% throughout the United States by land and air.

What We Offer

  • Competitive benefits: 401(k), health insurance, PTO, paid sick leave, and family leave.
  • Growth opportunities: On-the-job training, leadership development, and stretch assignments.
  • Career development: Opportunities to take on larger responsibilities as POP MART's North America business continues to scale.

As of the first half of 2026, POP MART had more than 100 million registered members worldwide, operated 676 physical stores and over 2,800 ROBO SHOP vending machines, and reached nearly 100 countries and regions through cross-border e-commerce platforms,bringing joy to consumers around the world.





Senior Manager, Real Estate

Location: Culver City, CA or New York, NY
Work Arrangement: On-site, 5 days per week
Department: Real Estate

Salary: $130,000 - $160,000

Opportunity Overview

POP MART is seeking an experienced and execution-driven Senior Manager, Real Estate to support the continued expansion of our retail footprint across the United States.

As POP MART rapidly grows its U.S. presence, this role will be responsible for turning our market expansion strategy into a strong pipeline of high-quality retail locations. You will lead site selection and evaluation, drive lease negotiations, manage transactions through execution, and partner cross-functionally to ensure new stores successfully move from initial opportunity through opening.

The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of U.S. retail real estate, strong relationships with landlords, developers, and brokers, and a proven ability to manage a high-volume pipeline of transactions in a fast-moving growth environment.

This is a highly visible opportunity to directly influence where and how POP MART grows across the U.S.

We follow an office policy with an expectation of five days per week working onsite. Being together in person helps us collaborate, stay connected, and build a strong team culture. At POP MART, we foster a high-trust environment and trust our employees to make decisions that support both the team and the business.

What You Will Achieve

Site Selection & Market Development

  • Lead end-to-end site identification and evaluation for new POP MART retail locations across priority U.S. markets.
  • Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective locations that supports the company's short- and long-term expansion plans.
  • Conduct comprehensive market and site assessments, including field visits, trade area analysis, traffic patterns, demographics, competitive positioning, co-tenancy, and overall market potential.
  • Identify opportunities across top-performing malls, lifestyle centers, high streets, tourist destinations, and major business districts.
  • Prepare and present site packages, financial considerations, market insights, and go/no-go recommendations to leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Monitor market activity and proactively identify emerging opportunities that could support POP MART's continued U.S. growth.

Lease Negotiation & Transactions

  • Lead LOI and lease negotiations for new retail locations, renewals, amendments, relocations, and other real estate transactions.
  • Negotiate favorable economic and operational terms while balancing financial objectives, operational requirements, and speed to market.
  • Partner closely with Legal throughout lease review and execution to ensure transactions move forward accurately and efficiently.
  • Maintain visibility into deal progress, financial terms, critical dates, approvals, and outstanding issues across the real estate pipeline.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with landlords, developers, brokers, property managers, and other real estate partners.
  • Leverage industry relationships and market knowledge to identify both marketed and off-market opportunities.

Pipeline & Portfolio Management

  • Manage multiple active deals simultaneously across different stages of the real estate lifecycle.
  • Maintain accurate and current pipeline reporting, ensuring leadership has visibility into deal status, risks, timelines, and upcoming decisions.
  • Proactively identify potential delays, deal risks, and roadblocks and drive solutions with the appropriate internal and external partners.
  • Support portfolio planning by providing market intelligence, landlord insights, competitive information, and recommendations on future expansion opportunities.
  • Partner with Finance to evaluate deal economics and ensure proposed locations align with business and investment expectations.

Cross-Functional Execution & Store Openings

  • Partner closely with Construction, Store Operations, Finance, Legal, Design, and other cross-functional teamsto successfully transition executed deals into new store openings.
  • Coordinate key real estate milestones and landlord deliverables from lease execution through construction and opening.
  • Serve as a key point of contact between landlords and internal teams throughout the development and build-out process.
  • Ensure landlord obligations, possession dates, delivery conditions, and other critical lease requirements are clearly communicated and tracked.
  • Support resolution of landlord, lease, or property-related issues that could impact construction timelines or store openings.
  • Conduct post-opening reviews and maintain complete and accurate transaction documentation.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • 8+ years of commercial real estate experience, with significant experience in retail site selection, leasing, and transaction management.
  • Demonstrated success managing a high-volume pipeline of retail real estate transactions from site identification through lease execution.
  • Strong understanding of major U.S. retail markets, shopping centers, lifestyle centers, high streets, and key commercial districts.
  • Established relationships within the retail real estate community, including landlords, developers, brokers, and other industry partners.
  • Strong lease and LOI negotiation experience with a demonstrated ability to secure favorable business and economic terms.
  • Experience supporting a multi-unit retail, consumer, hospitality, entertainment, or other rapidly expanding physical footprint strongly preferred.
  • Strong financial and analytical capabilities with the ability to evaluate site economics and make data-informed recommendations.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple transactions, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence both internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, self-motivated, and comfortable operating with a high degree of ownership.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where processes and priorities may continue to evolve.
  • Willingness to travel regularly for market tours, site visits, landlord meetings, and other business needs across the United States.

Location: Cabazon, CA

Department: Retail

Salary: $70,304-$80,304


 

Opportunity Overview:

At POP MART, we believe art has the power to inspire joy, spark imagination, and bring people together. As a Store Manager, you will be responsible for leading every aspect of the business, creating exceptional customer experience, developing high-performing teams, and driving operational excellence.
 

As the leader of your store, you'll build a culture that reflects POP MART's creativity, energy, and commitment to outstanding service. You'll own business performance, talent development, visual presentation, inventory management, and daily operations while ensuring every customer enjoys a premium retail experience.
 

You'll inspire your team to deliver exceptional results while bringing the excitement of POP MART's collectible characters, artists, and exclusive products to life.

This position reports directly to the District/Area Manager.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Create clear expectations, recognize achievements, and hold team members accountable for results.

    • Sales
    • Conversion

    • Average Transaction Value (ATV)
    • Payroll productivity
    • Inventory accuracy
    • Customer satisfaction
  • Analyze business trends and develop action plans to achieve or exceed performance goals.
  • Lead execution of product launches, limited-edition releases, and promotional campaigns.
     

Customer Experience

  • Champion an exceptional customer experience by creating an engaging, welcoming, and memorable shopping environment.

  • Serve as a brand ambassador by promoting POP MART's artists, characters, collectibles, and unique retail experience.
  • Resolve customer concerns professionally while building long-term customer loyalty.

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, operational procedures, safety standards, and loss prevention practices.
  • Oversee scheduling, payroll management, cash handling, inventory control, shipment processing, replenishment, and stockroom organization.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and visually compelling store environment that reflects POP MART's premium brand standards.
     

Visual Merchandising & Brand Execution

  • Execute visual merchandising strategies, marketing campaigns, promotional displays, and seasonal floor sets.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to implement new merchandising initiatives and store updates.
  • Ensure visual presentation consistently supports business objectives while delivering an engaging shopping experience.
     

Brand & Community

  • Support in-store events, pop-up activations, conventions, new store openings, and community engagement initiatives.
  • Partner with Robo Shop teams and business partners to support operational excellence where applicable.
  • Represent POP MART within the local community while helping grow brand awareness and customer engagement.
  • Maintain flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and peak business periods.
  • Travel up to 10% as needed to support new store openings, business meetings, training, or company initiatives, including occasional collaboration with international teams outside of standard business hours.

  • 3+ years of retail management experience leading high-volume, customer-focused retail stores.
  • Proven success managing sales performance, operational execution, and team development.
  • Experience leading teams of 10 or more employees, including coaching and developing leaders.
  • Strong understanding of retail KPIs and the ability to use business metrics to drive performance.
  • Experience executing visual merchandising standards and marketing initiatives.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving retail environment.
  • Passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences.
  • Appreciation of designer toys, collectibles, art, pop culture, or lifestyle brands is highly valued.

detail.jobDescription:
Founded in 2010, POP MART is a leading global pop culture and entertainment company. With IP at its core, POP MART works with artists and designers worldwide to develop and operate IPs, creating products, services and entertainment experiences for consumers. Its portfolio includes beloved IP characters such as THE MONSTERS , TWINKLE TWINKLE, CRYBABY, DIMOO, SKULLPANDA, Hirono and MOLLY. As of the first half of 2026, POP MART had more than 100 million registered members worldwide, operated 676 physical stores and over 2,800 ROBO SHOP vending machines, and reached nearly 100 countries and regions through cross-border e-commerce platforms,bringing joy to consumers around the world.





Insurance & Risk Coordinator

Location: Culver City, CA

Work Arrangement: On-site, 5 days per week

Department: Operations Support & Project Management

Salary: $85,000 - $105,000


Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Insurance & Risk Coordinator to support the insurance procurement, certificate of insurance (COI) management, and risk mitigation efforts for our rapidly growing retail footprint. This role is critical in ensuring our stores open and operate in full compliance with lease, legal, and operational requirements. The ideal candidate will have experience in retail insurance, strong organizational skills, and the ability to collaborate across finance, legal, operations, and external partners.


Key Responsibilities

Insurance Procurement & Management:

  • Lead the end-to-end process of obtaining and renewing property, general liability, workers’ compensation, and other relevant insurance policies for all retail locations.
  • Evaluate insurance proposals, negotiate terms, and ensure cost-effective coverage aligned with company risk tolerance.

Broker Relationship & Performance Evaluation:

  • Maintain ongoing relationship with the incumbent broker as primary point of contact for day-to-day service delivery.
  • Evaluate broker performance through service responsiveness, quote competitiveness, and alignment with company needs (informed judgment, not full negotiation).
  • Collect and compare quotes from multiple brokers (in line with US regulations allowing only one broker per carrier for branded retail) to support renewal / replacement decisions.

COI Issuance & Administration:

  • Generate, track, and distribute Certificates of Insurance (COIs) for landlords, vendors, and partners as required by lease agreements and operational contracts.
  • Ensure COIs accurately list additional insured parties and meet all contractual deadlines.

Compliance & Documentation:

  • Maintain a centralized database of all insurance policies, COIs, and related documents.
  • Conduct regular audits to ensure ongoing compliance across all store locations.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Finance teams to review lease insurance clauses and mitigate contractual risks.

Cross-functional Coordination:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for store operations teams, providing guidance on insurance-related matters for new store openings, renovations, and daily operations.
  • Liaise with insurance brokers, carriers, landlords, and internal stakeholders to resolve issues efficiently.

Risk Mitigation Support:

  • Assist in developing and implementing risk management protocols for retail operations.
  • Analyze claims data and provide insights to reduce future incidents and costs.

Claims & Incident Support:

  • Serve as the internal coordinator for insurance claims — track claim process with broker, collect documents, follow up across stakeholders.
  • Build basic claims / incident SOP from 0→1, including coordination with broker / Legal / store teams on consumer incidents (e.g., choking events).
  • Note: This role does not require deep personal claims-handling experience — the key skill is knowing how to ask the right questions and pushing the broker / partners to deliver.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Risk Management, or a related field.

Founded in 2010, POP MART is a leading global pop culture and entertainment company. With IP at its core, POP MART works with artists and designers worldwide to develop and operate IPs, creating products, services and entertainment experiences for consumers. POP MART (09992.HK), founded in 2010, is a leading global company in the trend culture and entertainment industry. Centered around IP, POP MART has built a comprehensive platform for creative incubation and IP operation, empowering global creators while delivering exciting products, services, and immersive entertainment experiences to consumers.

POP MART identifies and nurtures emerging artists and designers worldwide, creating popular character IPs through a well-established IP development and operation system. Its portfolio includes iconic IPs such as MOLLY, SKULLPANDA, DIMOO, THE MONSTERS, and Hirono. detail.jobDescription:

Position: Retail Operations Manager

Location: Culver City, CA
Department: Retail Operations
Salary: $95,000 - $115,000

POP MART (09992.HK), founded in 2010, is a leading global company in the trend culture and entertainment industry. Centered around IP, POP MART has built a comprehensive platform for creative incubation and IP operation, empowering global creators while delivering exciting products, services, and immersive entertainment experiences to consumers.

POP MART identifies and nurtures emerging artists and designers worldwide, creating popular character IPs through a well-established IP development and operation system. Its portfolio includes iconic IPs such as MOLLY,

SKULLPANDA, DIMOO, THE MONSTERS, and Hirono. By launching art toys and derivative products based n these IPs, POP MART continues to lead trends in consumer culture.

As of the end of 2025, POP MART operates over 630 physical stores and more than 2,637 Robo Shops across 20+ countries and regions. Through multiple retail channels and cross-border e-commerce platforms, POP MART continues to expand its global footprint while creating memorable experiences for fans around the world.

Opportunity Overview

We follow an office policy with an expectation of five days per week working onsite. Being together in person helps us collaborate, stay connected, and build a strong team culture. At POP MART, we foster a high-trust environment and empower our employees to make decisions that support both the business and our customers.

The Retail Operations Manager serves as the operational backbone of POP MART's North America retail business, transforming strategic initiatives into scalable processes that enable consistent execution across every store. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Retail Operations, this role is responsible for developing operational standards, driving process improvements, managing operational communications, and delivering data-driven insights that improve store performance and the customer experience.

This individual will partner closely with Retail Operations, Visual Merchandising, Marketing, Human Resources, IT, Finance, Loss Prevention, and Learning & Development to build best-in-class operating procedures, ensure compliance, and support one of the fastest-growing retail organizations in North America. Success in this role requires exceptional organizational skills, strong analytical capabilities, outstanding written communication, and a passion for continuous improvement.

What You Will Achieve

Retail Operations & Process Excellence

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that support consistent execution across all retail locations.

  • Own the operational documentation library, ensuring version control, accuracy, accessibility, and ongoing maintenance.

  • Translate business initiatives into clear, actionable operating procedures that enable store teams to execute with confidence.

  • Identify operational gaps through store feedback, field observations, and performance data, implementing process improvements that enhance efficiency and consistency.

  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives that simplify workflows and improve the store experience.

Operational Reporting & Business Analytics

  • Build, maintain, and distribute recurring operational dashboards, KPI reports, compliance scorecards, new store opening readiness reports, and executive summaries.

  • Analyze operational performance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Partner with senior leadership to provide actionable insights that support business decisions.

  • Improve reporting processes through automation, standardized templates, and enhanced data visualization.

  • Ensure operational data is accurate, timely, and presented in a clear, business-focused format.

Policy, Compliance & Operational Governance

  • Develop and maintain store operational policies that align with company standards, regulatory requirements, and brand expectations.

  • Conduct operational audits and compliance reviews to ensure stores are executing established procedures.

  • Partner with Human Resources, Legal, Finance, and Loss Prevention to maintain compliance across all operational documentation.

  • Maintain centralized operational resources and ensure stores always have access to the most current procedures and policies.

  • Monitor compliance trends and recommend corrective actions when necessary.

Retail Communication & Field Support

  • Own all operational communications directed to retail store teams, including SOP rollouts, policy updates, operational announcements, compliance reminders, and business initiatives.

  • Establish and maintain a structured communication cadence that delivers timely, organized, and actionable information to stores.

  • Translate complex cross-functional initiatives into concise, store-friendly communications that support execution.

  • Maintain communication archives and documentation for operational reference and compliance purposes.

  • Partner with field leadership to gather feedback and continuously improve communication effectiveness.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Collaborate with Retail Operations, Visual Merchandising, Marketing, HR, IT, Finance, Learning & Development, and other business partners to ensure operational readiness for launches, promotions, and new initiatives.

  • Support new store openings through operational planning, documentation, reporting, and communication.

  • Assist with executive presentations, business reviews, operational planning materials, and strategic initiatives.

  • Serve as a trusted operational resource across the organization by providing guidance on procedures, documentation, reporting, and best practices.

Operational Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to streamline operational processes and eliminate inefficiencies.

  • Evaluate operational tools, reporting platforms, and technologies that improve productivity and field execution.

  • Support initiatives focused on inventory management, shrink reduction, operational compliance, and store productivity.

  • Champion a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement throughout the retail organization.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Operations Management, Supply Chain, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 3-5 years of experience in retail operations, business operations, or multi-unit retail support.

  • Demonstrated experience developing SOPs, operational documentation, policies, or process improvements.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience building reports, dashboards, and KPI tracking.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, Power Query (preferred), conditional formatting, charts, and data validation.

  • Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to translate complex operational concepts into clear documentation.

  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Excellent attention to detail and a continuous improvement mindset.

  • Ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

  • Experience supporting large-scale retail operations in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting a multi-location retail organization.

  • Experience with retail POS systems, inventory management platforms, workforce scheduling systems, or retail analytics tools.

  • Experience creating executive dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar reporting platforms.

  • Familiarity with project management platforms such as Asana, Monday.com, Jira, or Smartsheet.

  • Experience supporting new store openings or operational expansion projects.

  • Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies is a plus.

  • Passion for consumer brands, retail innovation, pop culture, entertainment, or collectible products.

What we offer

  • Market-competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, paid sick leave, and family leave.

  • Professional development through leadership training, mentorship, and stretch assignments.

  • Career growth opportunities within one of the fastest-growing global entertainment and retail brands.

  • Exposure to executive leadership and cross-functional strategic initiatives.

  • The opportunity to build scalable operational processes that directly impact the success of POP MART's rapidly expanding North American retail business.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods while operating a computer or other office equipment.

  • Must be able to occasionally lift or move items weighing up to 25 pounds.

  • Must be able to travel occasionally to retail stores, new store openings, and company meetings as business needs require.

detail.title: Retail Store Manager - Tysons Corner
detail.jobDescription:
Founded in 2010, POP MART is a leading global pop culture and entertainment company. With IP at its core, POP MART works with artists and designers worldwide to develop and operate IPs, creating products, services and entertainment experiences for consumers. Its portfolio includes beloved IP characters such as THE MONSTERS , TWINKLE TWINKLE, CRYBABY, DIMOO, SKULLPANDA, Hirono and MOLLY. As of the first half of 2026, POP MART had more than 100 million registered members worldwide, operated 676 physical stores and over 2,800 ROBO SHOP vending machines, and reached nearly 100 countries and regions through cross-border e-commerce platforms,bringing joy to consumers around the world.





Position: Retail Store Manager

Location: Tysons Corner

Department: Retail

Salary: $75,000-$85,000


Opportunity Overview:

At POP MART, we believe art has the power to inspire joy, spark imagination, and bring people together. As a Store Manager, you will be responsible for leading every aspect of the business, creating exceptional customer experience, developing high-performing teams, and driving operational excellence.

As the leader of your store, you'll build a culture that reflects POP MART's creativity, energy, and commitment to outstanding service. You'll own business performance, talent development, visual presentation, inventory management, and daily operations while ensuring every customer enjoys a premium retail experience.

You'll inspire your team to deliver exceptional results while bringing the excitement of POP MART's collectible characters, artists, and exclusive products to life.
This position reports directly to the District/Area Manager.

What you will achieve:
Leadership & Talent Development
  • Recruit, hire, coach, develop, and retain a high-performing leadership team and store associates.
  • Foster a positive, inclusive, and customer-first culture that reflects POP MART's values and brand.
  • Conduct regular coaching, performance reviews, and development conversations to grow future leaders.
  • Create clear expectations, recognize achievements, and hold team members accountable for results.
  • Build succession plans and develop internal talent for future growth opportunities.

Business & Sales Performance
  • Own the overall financial performance of the store, including sales, payroll, expenses, profitability, and operational execution.
  • Drive key performance indicators (KPIs), including:
    • Sales
    • Conversion
    • Units Per Transaction (UPT)
    • Average Transaction Value (ATV)
    • Payroll productivity
    • Inventory accuracy
    • Customer satisfaction
  • Analyze business trends and develop action plans to achieve or exceed performance goals.
  • Lead execution of product launches, limited-edition releases, and promotional campaigns.

Customer Experience
  • Champion an exceptional customer experience by creating an engaging, welcoming, and memorable shopping environment.
  • Ensure every team member delivers knowledgeable product recommendations and meaningful customer interactions.
  • Serve as a brand ambassador by promoting POP MART's artists, characters, collectibles, and unique retail experience.
  • Resolve customer concerns professionally while building long-term customer loyalty.

Store Operations
  • Maintain full ownership of daily store operations, ensuring excellence in execution across all functional areas.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, operational procedures, safety standards, and loss prevention practices.
  • Oversee scheduling, payroll management, cash handling, inventory control, shipment processing, replenishment, and stockroom organization.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and visually compelling store environment that reflects POP MART's premium brand standards.

Visual Merchandising & Brand Execution
  • Execute visual merchandising strategies, marketing campaigns, promotional displays, and seasonal floor sets.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to implement new merchandising initiatives and store updates.
  • Ensure visual presentation consistently supports business objectives while delivering an engaging shopping experience.

Brand & Community
  • Support in-store events, pop-up activations, conventions, new store openings, and community engagement initiatives.
  • Partner with Robo Shop teams and business partners to support operational excellence where applicable.
  • Represent POP MART within the local community while helping grow brand awareness and customer engagement.
  • Maintain flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and peak business periods.
  • Travel up to 10% as needed to support new store openings, business meetings, training, or company initiatives, including occasional collaboration with international teams outside of standard business hours.

What you will need: 
  • 3+ years of retail management experience leading high-volume, customer-focused retail stores.
  • Proven success managing sales performance, operational execution, and team development.
  • Experience leading teams of 10 or more employees, including coaching and developing leaders.
  • Strong understanding of retail KPIs and the ability to use business metrics to drive performance.
  • Experience executing visual merchandising standards and marketing initiatives.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving retail environment.
  • Passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences.
  • Appreciation of designer toys, collectibles, art, pop culture, or lifestyle brands is highly valued.
  • Experience collaborating with international or cross-functional teams is a plus.
  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Retail Management, or a related field preferred.

What We Offer
  • Market-competitive packages: 401k, health insurance, PTO, paid sick leave, and family leave.
  • Growth opportunities: on-the-job training, leadership development, and stretch assignments to advance your career.
  • Career development: opportunities to take on larger responsibilities as POP MART's North America business scales rapidly.

Physical Requirements
  • Ability to regularly lift, carry, push, and move merchandise and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout scheduled shifts.
  • Ability to frequently bend, kneel, stoop, reach, climb ladders or step stools, and perform overhead work.
  • Ability to perform repetitive tasks such as receiving shipments, stocking merchandise, building displays, and organizing inventory.

  • Ability to multitask and respond effectively in a fast-paced retail environment.

Position: Regional Manager – Central Region
Location: Chicago, Illinois
Department: Retail
Salary: $160,000–$190,000

Opportunity Overview:

POP MART is seeking a strategic and highly experienced Regional Manager - Central Region to lead the long-term growth, performance, and leadership strategy for our rapidly expanding retail footprint across the Central U.S.

This role will translate company priorities into a clear regional strategy while overseeing financial performance, leadership development, market expansion, and cross-functional execution. The Regional Retail Director will lead through District and Area Managers, ensuring they have the strategy, resources, and accountability needed to deliver results across their markets.

This is a highly visible leadership position requiring approximately 80% travel throughout the region. The ideal candidate combines strong retail and financial acumen with executive-level communication, talent development, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

What You Will Achieve:

Regional Strategy & Business Planning

  • Define the strategic roadmap for the Central region, translating corporate priorities into multi-year regional growth and operating plans.
  • Analyze market, competitive, financial, and operational data to identify opportunities for expansion, operating model improvements, and retail format innovation.
  • Establish regional priorities and resource allocation, ensuring District and Area Managers remain focused on initiatives with the greatest business impact.
  • Present regional strategy, business performance, risks, opportunities, and forward-looking plans to executive leadership.
  • Maintain accountability for consistent execution of company standards while adapting regional strategies to local market needs.

Executive & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the region's senior point of contact for HR, Learning & Development, Retail Operations, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Real Estate, Construction, Finance, and IT.
  • Partner with cross-functional leaders to shape and prioritize pilots, program rollouts, new store initiatives, and special projects before they reach the field.
  • Bring field and market insights into corporate planning discussions to influence program design and business priorities.
  • Represent the region in leadership discussions, providing recommendations regarding program effectiveness, scalability, and return on investment.
  • Identify and escalate business risks, resource needs, and strategic trade-offs to appropriate stakeholders.

Talent Strategy & Leadership Development

  • Own the region's leadership pipeline strategy, identifying and developing high-potential multi-unit leaders for future senior leadership opportunities.
  • Establish a high standard for people leadership across the region while empowering District and Area Managers to own day-to-day team performance.
  • Lead succession planning and long-term workforce strategy for multi-unit leadership positions.
  • Coach District and Area Managers on leadership judgment, strategic decision-making, talent development, and business ownership.
  • Build a strong culture of accountability, collaboration, development, and high performance across the region.

Financial Strategy & Performance Oversight

  • Own regional P&L strategy and partner with Finance to establish budget priorities, financial targets, and profitability goals.
  • Analyze financial and operational trends to identify business opportunities and translate insights into strategic action plans.
  • Guide District and Area Managers on financial strategy, unit economics, labor productivity, and overall business performance.
  • Hold multi-unit leaders accountable for achieving financial and operational goals while identifying opportunities to improve profitability and efficiency.

Field Presence & Strategic Visibility

  • Maintain a strong field presence, with approximately 80% travel, to assess business performance, build relationships, and remain connected to market realities.
  • Conduct market and store visits to identify trends, opportunities, and operational challenges that can inform regional and corporate strategy.
  • Partner closely with field leadership while maintaining focus on strategic oversight rather than direct management of daily store operations.
  • Provide executive leadership with clear visibility into market conditions, business risks, and emerging opportunities.

  • Proven ability to translate corporate strategy into actionable regional plans and hold multi-unit leaders accountable for execution.
  • Experience leading, coaching, and developing District Managers, Area Managers, or comparable multi-unit leaders.
  • Strong track record of building succession plans and leadership pipelines across multiple markets.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior and executive stakeholders across multiple business functions.
  • Strong strategic thinking, business planning, and analytical capabilities.
  • Executive-level written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Strong financial acumen with the ability to translate data into business decisions and strategic priorities.
  • Ability to operate independently and make sound decisions in a fast-paced, rapidly scaling organization.
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 80% throughout the region.
  • Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience leading a large and geographically dispersed retail region within a high-growth, specialty retail, lifestyle, fashion, entertainment, or consumer brand.
  • Experience supporting significant retail expansion, including new market entry and new store openings.
  • Experience partnering closely with Real Estate, Construction, Visual Merchandising, Marketing, HR, Finance, and Retail Operations.
  • Experience operating within a global or international organization and partnering across multiple regions or cultures.

Position: Construction Project Manager

Location: LA

Salary: $120-145K

Opportunity Overview:

POP MART is seeking a skilled and driven Construction Project Manager to lead the execution of our retail expansion across the United States. As a global pioneer in designer toy culture, we’re building immersive retail spaces that reflect our brand’s creativity, innovation, and joyful spirit. This role is central to ensuring our stores are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality and design.

You’ll oversee multiple retail construction projects from concept to completion, collaborating with internal teams, architects, contractors, and vendors. Your expertise in budgeting, scheduling, and site management will be key to bringing POP MART’s vision to life in new markets. With a hands-on approach and a passion for precision, you’ll help shape the physical footprint of a brand that’s capturing hearts worldwide.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing company at the intersection of art, retail, and global culture—where your work will directly impact the customer experience and brand presence across the U.S.

We follow an office policy with an expectation of five days per week working onsite. Being together in person helps us collaborate, stay connected, and build a strong team culture. At POP MART, we foster a high-trust environment and trust our employees to make decisions that support both the team and the business.

  • Proactively manage changes in project scope, identify potential risks, create contingency plans as necessary, and partner with project team members and contractors, assuming accountability for their assigned work.

  • Manage the submittal of Requests for Information (RFIs) at the bid stage and during construction to ensure timely responses with the necessary information to advance the project. Review and process change proposals, proposal requests, supplemental instructions, and other contract documents.

  • Review General Contractor bids to determine the awarded contractor and overall schedule, and work with the general contractor to ensure the project is delivered smoothly, on time, and within budget.

  • Ensure the Architect of Record (AOR) has all required design elements, including internal markups, vendor markups, and shop drawings, incorporated into the set prior to bidding. Coordinate with the tenant’s design, operational, and technical providers to ensure accuracy in the development of the tenant’s construction documents and build-out.

  • Lead weekly construction progress meetings, including preparing meeting minutes, schedule updates, and change order logs. Document all material submittals, shop drawings, and finish selections for approval.

  • Stakeholder Management: Ability to effectively partner with architects, general contractors, landlords, vendors, designers, internal teams, and other project stakeholders.

  • Technical Skills: Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to effectively manage project documentation and reporting.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment while managing competing priorities and deadlines.

  • Strong communication, organization, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

POP MART is seeking energetic, customer-focused Sales Associates who are passionate about creating memorable shopping experiences and bringing our unique brand to life. Opportunity Overview:

As the leader of your store, you'll build a culture that reflects POP MART's creativity, energy, and commitment to outstanding service. You'll own business performance, talent development, visual presentation, inventory management, and daily operations while ensuring every customer enjoys a premium retail experience.

You'll inspire your team to deliver exceptional results while bringing the excitement of POP MART's collectible characters, artists, and exclusive products to life.
This position reports directly to the District/Area Manager.


What you will achieve:
Leadership & Talent Development
  • Recruit, hire, coach, develop, and retain a high-performing leadership team and store associates.
  • Foster a positive, inclusive, and customer-first culture that reflects POP MART's values and brand.
  • Conduct regular coaching, performance reviews, and development conversations to grow future leaders.
  • Create clear expectations, recognize achievements, and hold team members accountable for results.
  • Build succession plans and develop internal talent for future growth opportunities.

Business & Sales Performance
  • Own the overall financial performance of the store, including sales, payroll, expenses, profitability, and operational execution.
  • Drive key performance indicators (KPIs), including:
    • Sales
    • Conversion
    • Units Per Transaction (UPT)
    • Average Transaction Value (ATV)
    • Payroll productivity
    • Inventory accuracy
    • Customer satisfaction
  • Analyze business trends and develop action plans to achieve or exceed performance goals.
  • Lead execution of product launches, limited-edition releases, and promotional campaigns.

Customer Experience
  • Champion an exceptional customer experience by creating an engaging, welcoming, and memorable shopping environment.
  • Ensure every team member delivers knowledgeable product recommendations and meaningful customer interactions.
  • Serve as a brand ambassador by promoting POP MART's artists, characters, collectibles, and unique retail experience.
  • Resolve customer concerns professionally while building long-term customer loyalty.

Store Operations
  • Maintain full ownership of daily store operations, ensuring excellence in execution across all functional areas.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, operational procedures, safety standards, and loss prevention practices.
  • Oversee scheduling, payroll management, cash handling, inventory control, shipment processing, replenishment, and stockroom organization.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and visually compelling store environment that reflects POP MART's premium brand standards.

Visual Merchandising & Brand Execution
  • Execute visual merchandising strategies, marketing campaigns, promotional displays, and seasonal floor sets.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to implement new merchandising initiatives and store updates.
  • Ensure visual presentation consistently supports business objectives while delivering an engaging shopping experience.

Brand & Community
  • Support in-store events, pop-up activations, conventions, new store openings, and community engagement initiatives.
  • Partner with Robo Shop teams and business partners to support operational excellence where applicable.
  • Represent POP MART within the local community while helping grow brand awareness and customer engagement.
  • Maintain flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and peak business periods.
  • Travel up to 10% as needed to support new store openings, business meetings, training, or company initiatives, including occasional collaboration with international teams outside of standard business hours.

What you will need:
  • 3+ years of retail management experience leading high-volume, customer-focused retail stores.
  • Proven success managing sales performance, operational execution, and team development.
  • Experience leading teams of 10 or more employees, including coaching and developing leaders.
  • Strong understanding of retail KPIs and the ability to use business metrics to drive performance.
  • Experience executing visual merchandising standards and marketing initiatives.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving retail environment.
  • Passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences.
  • Appreciation of designer toys, collectibles, art, pop culture, or lifestyle brands is highly valued.
  • Experience collaborating with international or cross-functional teams is a plus.
  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Retail Management, or a related field preferred.

What We Offer
  • Market-competitive packages: 401k, health insurance, PTO, paid sick leave, and family leave.
  • Growth opportunities: on-the-job training, leadership development, and stretch assignments to advance your career.
  • Career development: opportunities to take on larger responsibilities as POP MART's North America business scales rapidly.

Position: Real Estate Lead - US & Canada

Location: Culver City, CA

Salary: $170,000 - $210,000

Opportunity Overview:

POP MART is seeking a highly organized and execution-driven Lead of Real Estate to lead the on-the-ground expansion of our retail stores and ROBO SHOP vending machines across the United States. As a global pioneer in designer toy culture, POP MART is rapidly scaling its physical presence — and this role is key to making that growth happen.

In this role, you will own the execution of our real estate pipeline — driving site selection, lease negotiations, and cross-functional coordination to open new locations. You will need deep market knowledge of U.S and Canada . retail real estate, strong relationships with landlords and developers, and the operational rigor to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-moving environment.

This is a unique opportunity to be at the center of POP MART’s U.S. growth, translating our expansion plans into physical locations and delivering results that are visible across the entire organization.


We follow an office policy with an expectation of five days per week working onsite. Being together in person helps us collaborate, stay connected, and build a strong team culture. At POP MART, we foster a high-trust environment and trust our employees to make decisions that support both the team and the business.

What You Will Achieve
Site Selection & Evaluation

  • Execute end-to-end site identification and evaluation for new store and ROBO SHOP locations across the U.S and Canada , working within defined market priorities and criteria set by leadership.
  • Conduct thorough site assessments including field visits, trade area analysis, traffic and demographic review, and competitive context.
  • Prepare and present site packages, investment summaries and recommendations to internal stakeholders for approval.
  • Maintain a healthy, well-documented pipeline of prospective locations to support ongoing expansion goals.

Lease Negotiation & Transactions

  • Lead lease negotiations, LOIs, and contract modifications, securing favorable economic and operational terms within approved deal parameters.
  • Partner with Legal to review and finalize lease agreements, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
  • Track deal progress and maintain accurate records of lease status, key dates, and financial terms across the portfolio.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with landlords, property managers, brokers, and developers to facilitate smooth transactions and unlock future opportunities.

Project Coordination & Store Launch

  • Coordinate closely with Construction, Operations, Legal and Merchandising to ensure all pre-opening activities are completed on schedule.
  • Manage project timelines and milestones from lease execution through grand opening, proactively identifying and resolving delays.
  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for landlords and internal teams throughout the build-out and opening process.
  • Conduct post-opening reviews and maintain complete, up-to-date project documentation and reporting.

Team Leadership

  • Hire, coach, and manage direct reports supporting the U.S. and Canada real estate pipeline, setting clear priorities and holding the team accountable to results.
  • Set team goals, deal targets, and market coverage plans aligned to overall expansion objectives.
  • Foster an inclusive, high-performance team culture, providing regular feedback, development opportunities, and mentorship.
  • Represent the real estate function in cross-functional leadership discussions, escalating risks and resource needs as appropriate.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher.
  • 10+ years of experience in retail real estate with a strong focus on site selection and negotiating leases; multi-unit retail brand experience preferred.
  • Proven track record of managing a high-volume pipeline of real estate transactions from prospecting through lease execution.
  • In-depth knowledge of top shopping centers, lifestyle centers, and major business districts across the United States.
  • Strong negotiation skills with experience securing favorable lease terms across diverse market conditions.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills; able to manage multiple deals and deadlines simultaneously without dropping the ball.
  • Ability to motivate & lead a team while fostering an inclusive working environment focused on collaboration with internal and external cross-functional partners.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills, including experience hiring, developing, and managing direct reports, setting clear goals and priorities, and holding a team accountable to results.
  • Strong communicator and collaborator — comfortable working across internal teams and with external landlords, brokers, and developers.
  • Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and dependable; thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for site visits and market coverage across the U.S and Canada 
  • Canada real estate experience is strongly preferred

Working closely with cross-functional teams and our global headquarters, you'll help translate consumer insights and market trends into actionable recommendations that influence product development, category planning, and long-term IP strategy.   • Develop clear, actionable recommendations to inform IP development and long-term strategy

Product and Market Translation

  • Partner with internal teams and HQ to provide clear input on what is resonating in-market and why
  • Identify white space across product categories and consumer segments, and translate these into direction for IP and merchandise development

Job Description

Position: Regional Finance Business Partner

Location: Culver City, CA (On-Site)

Department: Finance

Salary: 100K-150K

POP MART (09992.HK), founded in 2010, is a leading global company in the trend culture and entertainment industry. Centered around IP, POP MART has built a comprehensive platform for creative incubation and IP operation, empowering global creators while delivering exciting products, services, and immersive entertainment experiences to consumers.

POP MART identifies and nurtures emerging artists and designers worldwide, creating popular character IPs through a well-established IP development and operation system. Its portfolio includes iconic IPs such as MOLLY,

SKULLPANDA, DIMOO, THE MONSTERS, and Hirono. By launching art toys and derivative products based n these IPs, POP MART continues to lead trends in consumer culture.

As of the end of 2025, POP MART operates over 630 physical stores and more than 2,637 Robo Shops across 20+ countries and regions. Through multiple retail channels and cross-border e-commerce platforms, POP MART continues to expand its global footprint while creating memorable experiences for fans around the world.

Opportunity Overview

At POP MART, we're redefining the intersection of retail, entertainment, and designer collectibles. As one of the fastest-growing global consumer brands, we're expanding rapidly across North America and looking for a strategic finance leader to help drive that growth.

As the Regional Finance Business Partner, you will serve as the primary financial advisor to our North America retail organization, partnering closely with cross-functional leaders to drive profitability, improve operational performance, and support strategic decision-making. This is not a traditional accounting role—it's a highly visible business partnering position where you'll translate financial data into actionable insights, influence key investments, strengthen operational controls, and help shape the future of one of the world's fastest-growing retail organizations.

Success in this role requires strong financial acumen, commercial thinking, analytical problem-solving, and the ability to influence stakeholders across multiple functions. You'll collaborate with leaders throughout Retail, Commercial, Supply Chain, Construction, Merchandising, and Corporate Shared Services while supporting executive leadership with strategic planning, forecasting, and investment decisions.

What You Will Achieve

Drive Business Performance

  • Partner with Retail, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Operations leaders to improve profitability, operational efficiency, and business performance.
  • Go beyond reporting financial results by challenging assumptions, identifying root causes, and recommending data-driven solutions.
  • Deliver financial insights that influence strategic decisions and improve overall business outcomes.

Financial Planning & Business Insights

  • Lead the annual budgeting process, quarterly rolling forecasts, monthly business reviews, financial modeling, scenario planning, and profitability analysis.
  • Develop executive-ready reporting that transforms financial performance into clear, actionable business recommendations.
  • Identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities while providing strategic guidance to local leadership and global HQ.

Strategic Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the trusted finance partner for Retail Operations, Business Development, Construction, Key Accounts, Merchandising, and Supply Chain.
  • Collaborate closely with Accounting, Accounts Payable, Tax, Legal, IT, and Internal Audit to ensure business decisions are accurately reflected and operational challenges are resolved efficiently.
  • Build strong relationships across the organization to improve collaboration and execution.

Lead New Store Investment Decisions (CAPEX)

  • Partner with Retail Leadership, Business Development, and Construction teams to evaluate new store investments.
  • Develop store-level P&L models, CAPEX budgets, investment analyses, and executive approval packages.
  • Support capital allocation decisions by evaluating financial returns, risks, and long-term business impact.

Strengthen Inventory, Cash & Operational Governance

  • Improve visibility and governance across stores, warehouses, and logistics partners.
  • Enhance cash controls, inventory movement tracking, reconciliation, return processes, and logistics exception management.
  • Identify operational gaps and implement preventive controls that reduce risk before financial issues occur.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Design practical financial controls and governance processes that improve transparency without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Recommend process improvements that strengthen compliance, increase efficiency, and support scalable business growth.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement across finance and operations.

Influence Through Data

  • Leverage financial and operational data to uncover opportunities, answer critical business questions, and challenge conventional thinking.
  • Connect financial performance with operational execution to influence leadership decisions.
  • Drive meaningful business improvements through fact-based analysis and strategic recommendations.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or related discipline
  • 8+ years of experience in FP&A, Commercial Finance, Business Finance or Finance Business Partnering
  • Experience supporting retail, consumer products or multi-site operations is highly preferred
  • Experience working with cross-border or multinational organizations
  • Strong financial modeling and analytical skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting a multi-unit retail, consumer products, entertainment, or omnichannel business.
  • Previous Finance Business Partner experience supporting Retail, Commercial, Supply Chain, or Operations teams.
  • Strong financial modeling skills, including CAPEX, ROI, and new store investment analysis.
  • Experience with ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar) and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience developing executive-level financial reporting and presentations.
  • Knowledge of inventory management, retail KPIs, margin analysis, working capital, and cash flow management.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • CPA, CMA, MBA, or equivalent professional certification is a plus.
  • Passion for consumer brands, retail innovation, entertainment, pop culture, or collectible products.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), PTO, sick leave, and family leave.
  • Leadership development, mentorship, and stretch opportunities.
  • Career growth with one of the fastest-growing global entertainment and retail brands.
  • Exposure to executive leadership and strategic initiatives.
  • Opportunity to build scalable operational processes that directly support POP MART's North American growth.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to remain stationary for extended periods while using office equipment.
  • Occasionally lift up to 25 pounds.
  • Occasional travel to stores, new openings, and company meetings as needed.

Pay Range Details

Strategic Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, coach, and scale the Operations team, setting clear priorities and holding leaders accountable for results.

  • Ensure accountability across all operational leaders through performance management, attendance oversight, and consistent feedback.

Operational Excellence & Store Standards

  • Anticipate and resolve operational challenges at scale, driving consistent execution across all locations.

Policy, Compliance & Efficiency

  • Ensure full compliance with corporate policies, labor regulations, and legal requirements across the retail fleet.
  • Oversee payroll management, headcount planning, and hiring strategy to align with labor budgets and company profitability goals.
  • Ensure operational efficiency through streamlined processes, resource optimization, and ongoing cost controls.

Cross-Functional & Global Alignment

  • Act as the primary liaison between field operations and the support center, ensuring transparent and effective communication with Los Angeles and China offices.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Real Estate, Construction, HR, L&D, Marketing, Finance, and Visual Merchandising to ensure alignment and successful execution of initiatives.
  • Support product launches, brand activations, and marketing campaigns with seamless operational execution across the fleet.

New Store Openings & ROBO Operations

  • Oversee NSO planning and execution, from site readiness through Grand Opening, ensuring each store opens with operational excellence.
  • Provide leadership oversight for ROBO Shop operations, including performance optimization, staffing strategies, and sales-driving initiatives.

  • Work cross-functionally with IT to create data reporting tools and programs that streamline reporting and improve ease of use for all teams.

Executive Leadership Communication

  • Supports the creation of presentation content for Executive Leadership updates, ensuring materials are polished, data-driven, and aligned with business strategy.
  • Present operational updates to Field, Store, & Leadership teams, providing insights, recommendations, and status updates on departmental progress.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations Management, Retail Management, or related field.
  • 3+ years in a senior-level leadership role overseeing managers and/or cross-functional teams, either in a retail headquarters, corporate office, or support center environment.
  • Demonstrated success in building and leading high-performing operations teams in a fast-scaling retail environment.

Operational Expertise

  • Proven ability to develop scalable SOPs, policies, and best practices across multiple regions.

Analytical & Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, including: Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, conditional formatting, data validation, chart/graph creation, and basic macros (preferred).
  • Strong ability to turn raw data into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.

  • Serve as a professional first point of contact for the Head of Retail, liaising with the Los Angeles support center, China HQ, field leaders, and external partners.

Retail Operations Support (approx. 50%)

  • Support the cadence of store communications: help draft, format, schedule, and distribute weekly communications, operational updates, and policy rollouts to stores and field leaders, in partnership with the Store Communications Coordinator.
  • Assist with operational reporting: gather data inputs, maintain recurring reports and dashboards (e.g., KPIs, payroll and attendance tracking, checklist completion), and ensure accuracy and on-time delivery.
  • Support New Store Opening (NSO) and ROBO Shop execution: track milestones, coordinate supply and material orders, manage vendor and shipping logistics, and support Grand Opening readiness in partnership with the NSO Coordinators.
  • Maintain the Operations team's document library, including SOPs, policies, templates, and training materials, ensuring the latest versions are organized and accessible.
  • Process and track purchase orders, invoices, and Operations budget items; follow up with vendors and Finance to resolve discrepancies.
  • Coordinate meetings, agendas, and follow-ups for the Operations team, and support cross-functional projects with Real Estate, Construction, HR, L&D, Marketing, Finance, and Visual Merchandising.
  • Respond to and triage inbound requests from stores and field teams, routing questions to the right owner and closing the loop on time-sensitive issues.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify and streamline administrative and operational processes, and support ad hoc projects as the business scales.

What You Will Need

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Retail Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in an executive assistant, administrative, retail operations, or coordination role; experience supporting senior leaders in a retail or consumer brand environment strongly preferred.
  • Experience working in a fast-scaling, multi-unit retail environment is a plus.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Exceptional organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to juggle competing priorities across two workstreams and consistently meet deadlines.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Outlook, PowerPoint, and Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and chart creation preferred).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to write clearly for store, field, and executive audiences.
  • High degree of discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment when handling confidential information.
  • Proactive, resourceful, service-oriented mindset — anticipates needs, solves problems independently, and follows through without reminders.
  • Comfort working across time zones and cultures, including regular coordination with the Los Angeles support center and China HQ; Mandarin language skills are a plus but not required.
  • Flexibility to occasionally support early morning or evening coordination (time zones), store visits, and events.

What We Offer

  • Market-competitive packages: 401k, health insurance, PTO, paid sick leave, and family leave.
  • Growth opportunities: on-the-job training, leadership development, and stretch assignments to advance your career.
  • Career development: opportunities to take on larger responsibilities as POP MART's North America business scales rapidly.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position (e.g., seated or at a desk) for extended periods while operating a computer or other office equipment.
  • Must be able to occasionally lift or move items weighing up to 25 pounds.

detail.title: Vending Operations Coordinator
detail.jobDescription:
POP MART (09992.HK), founded in 2010, is a leading global company in the trend culture and entertainment industry. Centered around IP, POP MART has built a comprehensive platform for creative incubation and IP operation, empowering global creators while delivering exciting products, services, and immersive entertainment experiences to consumers.

POP MART identifies and nurtures emerging artists and designers worldwide, creating popular character IPs through a well-established IP development and operation system. Its portfolio includes iconic IPs such as MOLLY, SKULLPANDA, DIMOO, THE MONSTERS, and Hirono. By launching art toys and derivative products based on these IPs, POP MART continues to lead trends in consumer culture. As of the end of first half of 2025, POP MART operates over 550 physical stores and more than 2,500 Robo Shops across the world. Through multiple cross-border e-commerce platforms, the company has reached audiences in over 90 countries and regions, bringing joy to young consumers around the world.





POP MART (09992.HK), founded in 2010, is a leading global company in the trend culture and entertainment industry. Centered around IP, POP MART has built a comprehensive platform for creative incubation and IP operation, empowering global creators while delivering exciting products, services, and immersive entertainment experiences to consumers.

POP MART identifies and nurtures emerging artists and designers worldwide, creating popular character IPs through a well-established IP development and operation system. Its portfolio includes iconic IPs such as MOLLY, SKULLPANDA, DIMOO, THE MONSTERS, and Hirono. By launching art toys and derivative products based on these IPs, POP MART continues to lead trends in consumer culture.

As of the end of 2024, POP MART operates over 500 physical stores and more than 2,300 ROBO Shop across 30+ countries and regions. Through multiple cross-border e-commerce platforms, the company has reached audiences in over 90 countries and regions, bringing joy to young consumers around the world.

Opportunity Overview:

The Operations Coordinator is responsible for the daily operation of multiple POP MART ROBO Shop units, ensuring they are stocked, clean, functional, and performing at peak efficiency. This role is the frontline operator, providing field insights, performing routine audits, and coordinating restocks, recruiting and service actions across their assigned areas. Additionally, this role supports the project management of new ROBO Shop installations, relocations, and upgrades, ensuring all launch activities are executed on time and meet operational standards.

We follow an office policy with an expectation of five days per week working onsite. Being together in person helps us collaborate, stay connected, and build a strong team culture. At POP MART, we foster a high-trust environment and trust our employees to make decisions that support both the team and the business.

What You Will Achieve

  • Manage a multi‑unit POP MART ROBO Shop, performing regular onsite visits.
  • Respond to machine alerts, stockouts, and operational issues promptly.
  • Recruiting individuals, teams, or 3rd party partners to operate ROBO Shop.
  • Coordinate with restocking teams, vendors, and internal support.
  • Perform field audits: inventory accuracy, cleanliness, visual merchandising compliance.
  • Log visit notes, upload photos, and maintain accurate records.
  • Conduct basic troubleshooting and escalate technical issues.
  • Ensure product availability and uptime KPIs are met.
  • Execute resets, seasonal updates, and product transitions.
  • Support the end‑to‑end execution of new ROBO Shop installations, relocations, and upgrades.
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Retail Store Operations, Supply Chain, Allocation, etc.) to ensure launch readiness.
  • Perform on‑site installation tasks including basic setup, machine testing, merchandising, and initial calibration.
  • Document installation progress through photos, checklists, and launch status reports.
  • Validate machine functionality and QC standards before handoff to Operations.
  • Assist with vendor scheduling, access coordination, and on‑site troubleshooting during installs.
  • Ensure all new ROBO Shop meet brand, merchandising, and performance standards pre-launch.

KPIs / Success Metrics

  • Uptime % across assigned units
  • Inventory accuracy & stockout rate
  • Average response time to alerts
  • Completion of scheduled visits
  • Execution accuracy (resets, promos, planograms)
  • On‑time completion of tasks

What You Will Need

    • Strong reliability & time management
    • Problem-solving and independent decision-making
    • Attention to detail and operational discipline
    • Customer service mentality
    • Comfort in fast-paced field environments
    • Ability to manage timelines and coordinate multiple stakeholders
    • Strong organizational skills for tracking installation milestones

    Tools & Technical Skills

    • Internal dashboards (inventory, sales, alerts)
    • Basic mechanical troubleshooting
    • Smartphone-based reporting tools
    • Installation checklists & launch management tools
    • Basic familiarity with installation hardware and machine setup

    Physical Requirements

    • Lift/carry 20–40 lbs (product cases)
    • Stand, walk, and drive for extended periods
    • Comfortable working in malls, retail centers, airports
    • Ability to assist with basic machine installations and on-site setup tasks

    What We Offer

    • Market-competitive packages: we provide 401k, health insurance, PTO leave, paid sick leave, and family leave, etc.
    • Opportunities to learn and lead: we provide on-the-job training to ensure employees are equipped with the most up-to-date skill sets and knowledge
    • Career development: we work with you to advance your career through short-term assignments, and new experiences, etc.
